messages: mona: quick design question — trace viewer header. thinking we should move the correlation-id pill from the far right into the metadata row next to the trace title so its easier to scan when you land on a trace. also want to swap the primary action order (Download > Copy) to Copy first for quick triage flows. thoughts? :thinking_face: alex: I like moving the pill closer to the title — reduces eye travel. curious about copy though: right now its `Corr ID`. Accessibility folks will probably ask for the full word `Correlation ID`. that will be wider and might push other metadata out on smaller widths. jean: if we go full `Correlation ID` we should use an abbreviated visual label + full label for screen readers, e.g. `aria-label="Correlation ID: 123..."` and visible `Corr. ID` or a tooltip. mock:```html Corr. ID · 7a3f2b ``` mona: @jean that approach seems reasonable — visual brevity + SR clarity. can we check contrast? current pill bg is #eef2ff with #1f2d5a text; ratio might be close. designbot: accessibility check: background #eef2ff vs text #1f2d5a => contrast 3.9:1 (AA large only). Recommend darkening text to #0f1b3a or increasing weight. sam: +1 on improving contrast. also: keyboard nav — want pill to be in the natural tab order after the title link. currently tabbing jumps title -> actions -> pill which is odd. should be title -> pill -> actions. small DOM reorder. taylor: technically fine to reorder DOM but note the analytics toolbar is a separate region (for screenreader grouping). if we move pill into title row we should mark it as part of the header region and keep semantic separation for the toolbar. I can update the markup but will need a tiny CSS tweak for responsive collapse. alex: back to CTAs: why Copy first? most folks triaging will copy correlation id into bug reports or search. Download is heavier. If Copy is primary we should make it visually primary (filled) and Download secondary (outline). jean: visually primary for copy feels odd — copy is destructive? but it is the fastest. maybe keep both subtle: primary color for Copy, smaller Download icon & label. Also change the copy text from `Copy ID` to `Copy correlation id` for clarity in keyboard labels, but visual label can be `Copy`. For SR: `aria-label="Copy correlation id to clipboard"`. mona: ok proposal summary: 1) Move pill next to title in DOM, 2) pill shows `Corr. ID · 7a3f2b` visually with `aria-label="Correlation ID: 7a3f2b"`, 3) increase pill contrast, 4) change action order to [Copy (primary), Download], 5) ensure tab order title -> pill -> copy -> download -> other actions. anyone blocking? taylor: no blocker, I'll PR the DOM reorder + aria changes. Will leave visual polish to @jean for spacing and contrast tokens. jean: I'll push a quick style patch and a couple of narrow-width mocks. attaching two screenshots in a follow-up message. :sparkles: alex: thanks all — let's land this before the next release so support can use consistent CTAs in runbook snippets. :thumbsup: mona: thanks team! filing a tiny product task for rollout notes and runbook changes.
